transcript: I observe myself, my responses, my reactions, don't do this as a means of judgment, but I do that because observation is important. Addressing things with yourself is important, accountability is important. I am proactive in my life because not every door will magically open for me. There are steps that I have to take. There are challenges that I have to explore and experience in order to shift through different seasons. I'm not afraid to look at myself in the mirror and address things that need to be corrected.
